searchText: What is a good website that tracks base fee over time and in realtime? I would like one website that answers the following questions: 1. What is the base fee of the latest block? 2. What is the base fee of the pending block? 3. What is the last time the base fee was below x? 4. What does base fee seasonality look like over the last day? 5. What does base fee seasonality look like over the last month? 6. What does the base fee seasonality look like over all time? Most (but not all) should be shown at watchtheburn.com You can head over to the 'insights' for base fee data over time
